name: Eshi ~Kakusareta Omoi~
source:
Taisho era. 
Young painter's works suddenly starts to illuminate, and girls' features on the portrait look as if moving.
At the same time a disturbing shadow shows up around the models...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
大正时代。
一名年轻画家的作品突然开始发光，肖像中的少女仿佛也在活动。
与此同时，模特们身边出现了一道令人不安的黑影…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
